name: Neil North
biography: Neil North (18 October 1932 – 7 March 2007) was a British actor, best known for his role in the 1948 film adaptation of Terence Rattigan's play The Winslow Boy.[1] North appeared in four other films released between 1948 and 1951 but did not make acting a full-time career. After a hiatus of over 40 years, however, he did return to the screen with three further credits towards the end of his life, including a role in the 1999 remake of The Winslow Boy.
